data.exit_load:
1% of applicable Net Asset Value – If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of 
the Fund are redeemed or switched out within 15 days from the date of allotment.
Nil - If units purchased or switched in from another scheme of the Fund are redeemed or 
switched out after 15 days from the date of allotment.
